definitions.explanation: Combining or considering all aspects, parts, or factors as a whole.

examples.japanese: {総合的|そうごうてき}な{判断|はんだん}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
{総合的|そうごうてき}に{見|み}て、このプランが{最|もっと}も{良|よ}い。
examples.english: Looking at it overall, this plan is the best.

examples.japanese: {総合的|そうごうてき}な{学習|がくしゅう}の{時間|じかん}が{設|もう}けられた。
examples.english: Time for integrated learning was established.
examples.notes: Refers to the Japanese school curriculum

notes:
FORMS:
・Adverbial: {総合的|そうごうてき}に (comprehensively, overall)
・Noun: {総合|そうごう} (synthesis, comprehensive)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{総合的|そうごうてき}な{判断|はんだん}/{評価|ひょうか} (comprehensive judgment/evaluation)
・{総合的|そうごうてき}に{考|かんが}える (to consider comprehensively)
・{総合的|そうごうてき}な{対策|たいさく} (comprehensive measures)

RELATED TERMS:
・{総合|そうごう}{病院|びょういん} (general hospital)
・{総合的|そうごうてき}な{学習|がくしゅう}の{時間|じかん} (Period for Integrated Studies - part of Japanese school curriculum)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{全体的|ぜんたいてき}: Overall (emphasizes the whole)
・{総合的|そうごうてき}: Comprehensive (emphasizes integration of parts)
